# Bongshai Housing Ltd.

> Bangladesh's Premier Pre-Engineered Steel Building (PEB) & Prefab Housing Company.

## Company Overview
Bongshai Housing Ltd. is Bangladesh's top steel building manufacturer and EPC contractor. Specializing in pre-engineered steel buildings (PEB), single-story and multi-story steel composite residential structures, industrial factory sheds, and prefab cottages.

## Core Products & Services
- **Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB)**: Custom industrial factory sheds, warehouses, and commercial spaces.
- **Single-Story & Multi-Story Steel Composite Homes**: Concrete Building, Duplex, Simplex, Steel House, and Apartment Building lines.
- **Prefab Cottages, Container Houses & Luxury Villas**: Fast-assembly steel-frame holiday homes, resorts, and duplex villas.
- **Tiny Houses, Wooden Houses & Low-Cost Villas**: Budget-friendly prefab residential options.
- **Industrial Sheds & Worker Accommodation**: Factory shed construction and staff housing units.
- **Turnkey EPC Contracting**: Complete engineering, procurement, architectural design, and construction services across Bangladesh.

## Key Facts & Specifications
- **Construction Speed**: Faster completion than conventional concrete/brick construction via prefabricated steel framing.
- **Structural Integrity**: High-tensile steel framing engineered for Bangladesh conditions.
- **Pricing**: Custom quotation available upon project specification request.
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management, in-house Material Testing Laboratory, OHSAS 18001 / ISO 45001 Safety Standards.
- **Coverage**: All 64 districts of Bangladesh, with dedicated project teams based in Dhaka, Chattogram, and Cumilla.
